Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment tests I1, which must performed every two 
 months as indicated by M2 in the titled block
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Salah kamel Mostafa (HV-Dep. Manager), tested by eng. 
Sahar Mohamed Ali, accepted by eng. 
Sayed Mahmoud 
Hessain Farag; general director, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abd 
El-Qader El-Nagar, approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abdel 
Latif Mady head sector of Ataka PS.
This document accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilil: EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, 
 ... etc.
Potential transformer must be isolated and proper grounded is required
Wear safety 
 belt because there is danger of falling off the top of the PT stack when cleaning 
 insulators or checking connections.
Presence the safety 
 supervisor is required.
Caution: Secondary PT wiring could be energized 
 through back feeds, make sure circuit breaker to secondary circuit is open
Tools 
and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety belt, rags, and silicagel
Safety helmet, safety belt, rags, and silicagel
Voltage indicator.
Tool set for tightness,
Cleaning tools as cloth .... etc
Works to be Carried Out
Check primary bus connection for tightness
Check for any signs of oil leaks
Check porcelains for chips, cracks, cementing, and fastenings.
Thoroughly clean all porcelain surfaces.
Check for signs 
 of overheating or flashovers.
